settings.title: 1. Place your order
settings.text: Choose the compound test, add-ons, and turnaround. Complete sample details on the product form so they attach to the order.

settings.title: 2. Ship the sample
settings.text: The confirmation email includes the lab receiving address and the order number to mark on the package. Do not require a signature. Packaging notes are included in that email.

settings.title: 3. Receive the report
settings.text: Results are issued as a certificate of analysis by email. Certificates are delivered only to the customer and are never published publicly.
